content_zh:
“战神界面，我想问一件事情。”
“请讲。”系统回复道。
“为什么很多战斗技巧和经历，我都想不起来了？”
“你刚刚穿越了时空，在时空乱流之中造成了风暴一般的影响。”
“许多恐怖的存在感受到了这种不正常的现象，它们正在寻找事情的源头。”
“所以你现在必须被封印一部分记忆，隐藏起来，等待一切平息之后，我会寻找合适的契机，解开你记忆的封印。”
顾青山听着，默默的叹了口气。
忽然间，他觉得身上传来隐隐的疼痛。
低头一看，却见身上各处雪白的绷带上，浸出了丝丝鲜血。
是了，身体伤势未愈，还处于恢复阶段，这样一用力当然让伤口有些迸裂。
顾青山放下军弓，找了张行军榻，翻上去就开始休息。
凡事不能操之过急，必须沉住气。
顾青山摸出仅剩的一粒疗伤丹，毫不犹豫的吞了下去。
他闭上眼睛，开始默默搬运灵气，化开药力。
一夜无话。
天亮的时候，雨下的更大了。
气候在逐渐变冷，雨水中夹杂的寒气浸透了大地。
再有数十天，冬天就来了。
顾青山是被冻醒的。
他起身活动了一下，发觉身上的伤口已经初步愈合。

军用的疗伤丹果然不是盖的，恢复伤势如此有效。
不一会儿，门被敲开。
赵六又煮了一锅粥，殷勤的端了进来。
顾青山看了看冒着热气的锅，闻着清粥的香味，问道：“粮食还有多少？”
赵六唉声叹气道：“只够再吃一天半。”说完，偷眼去瞄顾青山腰上的储物袋。
顾青山发觉了，但是没说什么。
在穿越而来的时候，他的储物袋也被一并清空了。
顾青山盛了粥，默默吃完早饭。
“你的伤，怎么样了？”赵六眼中带着希翼。
“好多了，”顾青山伸伸胳膊腿，顺便问道：“老赵，你是哪个营的？什么兵种？”
赵六脸上带着勉强的笑，道：“我是伙事营的，平日里几百人的饭菜都能做得。”
原来是个伙房铛头，难怪一碗粥都能熬出好味道。
这样的困境，若是没有顾青山，对赵六这个普通人来说，就是必死的绝望之境。
可是赵六不知道，顾青山也只有炼气一层修为，遇上一小队妖魔的话，顾青山也是立刻就被斩杀的结局。
顾青山默默的想着，又看了看操作界面上方的沙漏。
沙漏中的沙不多了，几乎快要见底。
这似乎跟正式游戏不同。
沙漏旁，几行萤火小字对此做出了说明：当玩家在修行世界呆满一天之后，将会返回现实世界。
顾青山现在无比渴望知道，真实世界现在是哪一年。
早饭吃到一半，两人同时停下手中动作。

“顾兄弟，外面好像有动静。”赵六身子往后缩了缩，小声说道。
“我去看看。”顾青山说着，抓起军弓就往外走。
沙漏只剩下十多分钟的样子，希望不要出什么大乱子。
顾青山走出房门，抽出一支箭矢按上弓弦，眯着眼打量四周。
他的双眼飞速扫过每一处建筑，不放过任何一个角落。
一般来说，营地里有隐匿法阵，妖魔不会轻易撞进来。
究竟是什么东西？
沙、沙、沙，声音再次响起。
这个方位，却是在军营门口。
顾青山贴着墙，悄无声息的移动过去。
一头两人高、身形庞大的妖兽出现在顾青山视野中。
这只妖兽摇头晃尾，立在死人坑边上，小心而警惕的打量四周。
虽然有着暴雨不断冲刷，但死人坑中的血腥气，终究是引来了妖兽。
顾青山藏在屋檐下的阴影中，举起军弓，慢慢拉开弓弦。
他认识这怪物。
这是一种低阶妖兽，虽然看上去有些笨拙，但要是发起狂来，冲撞和撕咬的能力也是很可怕的，寻常两三名士兵几乎都无法近身。
顾青山暗叹一声侥幸。
幸好自己选择了远程攻击，再加上营地的隐匿法阵掩护，说不定能建功。
妖兽绕着死人坑来回小跑，不时在地上打个滚。
它试探着，看周围是否有陷阱，或是有其他妖兽埋伏。

沙漏还有十分钟。
顾青山默默的握着弓箭，一动不动。
妖兽停下来，打着响鼻，硕大的头颅依然警惕的四处晃动。
还剩五分钟。
顾青山依旧不动。
妖兽终于慢慢低下了头，准备吃一具士兵的遗体。
它的鼻子在遗体上来回嗅了好一会儿，终于张开满是獠牙的大嘴。

content_en:
"God of War interface, I want to ask something."
"Please speak." The system replied.
"Why can't I remember many combat skills and experiences?"
"You just traveled through time and space, causing a storm-like impact in the turbulence of time and space."
"Many terrifying beings have sensed this abnormal phenomenon, and they are looking for the source of the matter."
"So now you have to seal part of your memory and hide it. After everything calms down, I will look for a suitable opportunity to unlock the seal of your memory."
Gu Qingshan listened and sighed silently.
Suddenly, he felt a dull pain coming from his body.
When he looked down, he saw traces of blood dripping from the white bandages all over his body.
Yes, the physical injury has not healed and is still in the recovery stage. Such exertion will certainly cause the wound to burst.
Gu Qingshan put down his military bow, found a military couch, climbed on it and began to rest.
You can't do anything too hastily, you must stay calm.
Gu Qingshan took out the only remaining healing pill and swallowed it without hesitation.
He closed his eyes and began to silently transport the spiritual energy and dissolve the medicine.
A night of silence.
At dawn, it rained harder.
The climate is gradually getting colder, and the cold air mixed in the rain soaks the earth.
In a few dozen days, winter will come.
Gu Qingshan woke up from the cold.
He stood up and moved around, and found that the wounds on his body had initially healed.
The military healing elixir is indeed not a guarantee, it is so effective in restoring injuries.
After a while, the door was knocked open.
Zhao Liu cooked another pot of porridge and brought it in diligently.
Gu Qingshan looked at the steaming pot, smelled the aroma of the porridge, and asked, "How much food is left?"
Zhao Liu sighed and said: "It's only enough for another day and a half." After saying that, he secretly glanced at the storage bag on the side of Qingshan.
Gu Qingshan noticed it, but didn't say anything.
When he traveled through time, his storage bag was also emptied.
Gu Qingshan filled the porridge and finished breakfast in silence.
"How is your injury?" Zhao Liu had hope in his eyes.
"Much better," Gu Qingshan stretched his arms and legs and asked by the way: "Old Zhao, which battalion are you from? What kind of military branch are you from?"
Zhao Liu had a forced smile on his face and said, "I work in a gang camp. I can usually cook meals for hundreds of people."
It turned out to be a kitchen cook. No wonder a bowl of porridge tastes good.
Such a predicament, if it were not for Gu Qingshan, would have been a desperate situation for ordinary people like Zhao Liu.
But Zhao Liu didn't know that Gu Qingshan was only at the first level of Qi refining. If he encountered a small group of demons, Gu Qingshan would be killed immediately.
Gu Qingshan thought silently and looked at the hourglass above the operation interface.
There is not much sand left in the hourglass and it is almost reaching the bottom.
This seems different from the official game.
Next to the hourglass, a few lines of small firefly characters explain this: when the player stays in the practice world for a full day, he will return to the real world.
Gu Qingshan is now extremely eager to know what year it is in the real world.
Halfway through breakfast, the two of them stopped what they were doing at the same time.
"Brother Gu, there seems to be something moving outside." Zhao Liu shrank back and whispered.
"I'll go take a look." Gu Qingshan said, grabbed the military bow and walked out.
There are only about ten minutes left in the hourglass, so I hope there won't be any big trouble.
Gu Qingshan walked out of the room, took out an arrow and pressed it on the bowstring, squinting and looking around.
His eyes quickly scanned every building, not missing any corner.
Generally speaking, there is a concealment circle in the camp, and monsters will not easily break in.
What exactly is it?
Sand, sand, sand, the sound sounded again.
This location is at the entrance of the military camp.
Gu Qingshan pressed against the wall and moved over quietly.
A monster beast that was two people tall and huge appeared in Gu Qingshan's field of vision.
This monster shook its head and tail,Standing on the edge of the death pit, he looked around carefully and vigilantly.
Although the heavy rain continued to wash away, the bloody smell in the death pit finally attracted the monsters.
Gu Qingshan hid in the shadow under the eaves, raised his military bow, and slowly drew the bowstring.
He knew this monster.
This is a low-level monster. Although it looks a bit clumsy, if it goes crazy, its ability to charge and bite is also very terrifying. It is almost impossible for two or three soldiers to get close to it.
Gu Qingshan secretly sighed that he was lucky.
Fortunately, I chose long-range attack, and coupled with the cover of the concealment circle in the camp, I might be able to accomplish something.
The monster trotted back and forth around the pit of the dead, rolling on the ground from time to time.
It was testing to see if there were any traps or other monsters ambushing it.
There are still ten minutes left in the hourglass.
Gu Qingshan silently held the bow and arrow, motionless.
The monster stopped and snorted, its huge head still shaking around vigilantly.
Five minutes left.
Gu Qingshan remained motionless.
The monster finally slowly lowered its head, preparing to eat a soldier's body.
Its nose sniffed back and forth on the body for a long time, and finally opened its big mouth full of fangs.
